description: An elderly man in a red velvet cape with white fur trim and a red skullcap sits at a dark wooden desk writing with a quill on a long scroll with a red wax seal. A black-robed man stands at his shoulder reading a sheet of paper. Two clergy in black cassocks stand with bowed heads near the right wall. The room is ornate, with gilt picture frames, a crucifix on the wall, a tall window with drapes, and a stack of papers on the desk.
